subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet along the lines. In the cube so formed, which letter will be on the face opposite the face showing the letter B?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a245a46dd0104624d24c32a0842ea74798e77a5f93e26044823db14d5b28ff35.png]
solution:
After folding the sheet, the following faces are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a12a52eb150721a8d0abe2aca60ea78cc0648548e35b787dab33414922006f0.png] 

 
 

 Letter
 Opposite
 
 

 A
 D
 
 

 F
 B
 
 

 E
 C
 
 

Here, the Opposite pairs are A and D,** F and B**, and E and C so the opposite face of B will be F.

Hence, **Option (3) **is the answer.
